title: Riverside Rush
description: Follow the upper river into rapids, race across bridges, climb the cliffs, then rush downhill alongside the water. Expert redesign: river jets and drifting log cutters.

identity.scope: Decoration reference route; not a final five-minute day
identity.visual_source: Original generated pixel-art plate with native animated scenery

rooms.name: The upper riverbank
rooms.lesson: Keep your rhythm beside the current. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: At the rapids edge

rooms.name: The bridge network

rooms.name: Down beside the river
rooms.lesson: Carry the current’s direction into the descent. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.
